value.description: A small, slow-growing bush whose woody stem forks once into two level arms, like a T grown into a shrub. At the tip of each arm hangs at most a single golden fruit, glowing softly enough to be found by its light at dusk. Ambrosia fruit is sweet, delicate and lifts the mood of anyone who eats it; it cannot be farmed, it will not be hurried, and a wild stand of it has been worth a war more than once.
